summary: This newly developed four bedroom Georgian style townhouse is just a short stroll from the Barnard Castle, charming cobbled streets, and vibrant town centre, this property offers a truly exceptional lifestyle opportunity in one of County Durham’s most sought-after addresses.
description:
Spread across three thoughtfully designed floors, the home showcases a seamless balance of heritage inspired features and contemporary refinement. Tall ceilings, sash windows, and intricate detailing fill the interiors with light and character, creating a sense of sophistication throughout. At the centre of the home lies a stunning kitchen, with an expansive granite island forming the natural hub for family and entertaining. Integrated, state-of-the-art appliances and a carefully considered layout make the space both functional and stylish. Bifold doors open onto a private walled garden, creating the perfect setting for al fresco dining or quiet relaxation. The luxurious master suite provides a private retreat, complete with a walk-in dressing room and a beautifully finished en-suite bathroom featuring high end fittings and a rainfall shower. Three further generously sized bedrooms are complemented by a spa-inspired family bathroom, where a freestanding bath and sleek waterfall shower bring hotel-style indulgence into everyday living.

Every element of this residence has been crafted with precision and care. It boasts glass doors and custom-made staircases and a high-quality finish that run throughout. The result is a home that feels both striking and welcoming, marrying grandeur with comfort in equal measure. The rear garden is currently designed with CGI to enhance the current gardens potential. Perfectly positioned, the property offers easy access to boutique shopping, excellent dining, and well-regarded schools, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.
